senses.en: A large boat carrying people or goods, especially at sea.
To send goods somewhere by sea, air, or land.

ex.en: We watched a huge ship glide into the harbour.
ex.zh: 我们看着一艘巨轮缓缓驶入港口。

ex.en: Many countries ship agricultural products overseas, making reliable transport networks essential for economic growth.
ex.zh: 许多国家向海外运送农产品，因此可靠的运输网络对经济增长至关重要。

tip: ship作动词不只指海运，也可指陆运或空运。

senses.en: A soft, comfortable shoe worn inside the home.

ex.en: I found my missing slipper underneath the sofa.
ex.zh: 我在沙发下面找到了丢失的那只拖鞋。

ex.en: Providing slippers in shared accommodation can improve comfort, although regular cleaning remains essential for good hygiene.
ex.zh: 在合住场所提供拖鞋能提升舒适度，但保持良好卫生仍离不开定期清洁。

col: a pair of slippers｜一双拖鞋
put on your slippers｜穿上拖鞋
tip: 通常用复数slippers；人字拖常叫flip-flops。

senses.en: In a way that is poor, unsuccessful, or unacceptable
To a serious or harmful degree
Very much, especially when wanting or needing something

ex.en: I slept badly because the room was too hot.
ex.zh: 房间太热，我睡得很不好。

ex.en: Poorly maintained roads can badly affect rural communities by limiting access to schools, hospitals, and markets.
ex.zh: 维护不善的道路会限制人们前往学校、医院和市场，严重影响农村社区。

tip: 比较级worse，最高级worst；不是bad的形容词用法。

senses.en: to find how many things there are
to matter or have an important effect
the act of counting, or the total found

ex.en: Please count the plates before our guests arrive.
ex.zh: 请在客人到来之前数一下盘子。

ex.en: When evaluating educational success, students' confidence and creativity should count as much as examination results.
ex.zh: 评估教育成效时，学生的自信和创造力应与考试成绩同样重要。

col: lose count｜数不清；忘记数到哪里
every minute counts｜每分钟都很重要
tip: count on意为依靠；count作“重要”时不及物。

senses.en: The conditions and events affecting someone or something at a time.

ex.en: We faced a difficult situation when our car broke down.
ex.zh: 汽车抛锚时，我们陷入了困境。

ex.en: The housing situation has become increasingly difficult for young people living in major cities.
ex.zh: 对居住在大城市的年轻人来说，住房形势已变得日益严峻。

col: deal with a situation｜应对某种情况
tip: 表示处于某种情况，用in a situation。

senses.en: a person who flies an aircraft
done on a small scale to test whether something works
to fly an aircraft or test a new plan

ex.en: The pilot landed the plane smoothly despite strong winds.
ex.zh: 尽管风很大，飞行员还是平稳地让飞机着陆了。

ex.en: The council launched a pilot scheme to assess whether free bus travel would reduce traffic congestion.
ex.zh: 地方议会推出了一项试点计划，以评估免费乘坐公交车能否缓解交通拥堵。

col: pilot a programme｜试行一个项目
tip: pilot作定语常表示试点，如pilot project。

senses.en: To keep doing something or keep happening.
To start again after a pause or interruption.

ex.en: We continued walking along the beach despite the rain.
ex.zh: 尽管下着雨，我们还是继续沿着海滩走。

ex.en: If housing costs continue to rise, more young adults may struggle to live independently in major cities.
ex.zh: 如果住房成本持续上涨，更多年轻人可能难以在大城市独立生活。

tip: 可接to do或doing，通常都表示继续做某事。

senses.en: a large green-skinned fruit with juicy, usually red flesh

ex.en: We shared a cold watermelon after playing outside.
ex.zh: 在外面玩耍后，我们一起吃了一个冰凉的西瓜。

ex.en: Growing watermelons in dry regions requires careful irrigation management to protect limited local water supplies.
ex.zh: 在干旱地区种植西瓜需要谨慎管理灌溉，以保护当地有限的水资源。

col: a slice of watermelon｜一片西瓜
tip: 整个西瓜可数；指切开的瓜肉时常不可数。

senses.en: The organ that pumps blood around the body.
The part of someone associated with feelings and love.
The central or most important part of something.

ex.en: My heart beats faster when I run uphill.
ex.zh: 我跑上坡时，心跳会加快。

ex.en: Regular physical activity strengthens the heart and can reduce the risk of serious illness.
ex.zh: 经常运动能增强心脏功能，并降低患严重疾病的风险。

col: at the heart of｜处于……的核心
tip: by heart表示熟记；lose heart表示灰心。

senses.en: not wet or containing very little moisture
to remove moisture or become free from moisture
not interesting or entertaining

ex.en: The towels are dry after hanging in the sunshine.
ex.zh: 毛巾在阳光下晾过后已经干了。

ex.en: Long periods of dry weather can damage crops and threaten food security in agricultural communities.
ex.zh: 长期干旱天气会损害农作物，并威胁农业社区的粮食安全。

tip: 形容词比较级drier；名词dryer指烘干设备。

senses.en: A covered vehicle used to carry goods or people.

ex.en: We loaded the boxes into a small white van.
ex.zh: 我们把箱子装进了一辆白色的小型厢式货车。

ex.en: Replacing diesel delivery vans with electric vehicles could help reduce air pollution in densely populated cities.
ex.zh: 用电动车替换柴油送货车，有助于减少人口密集城市的空气污染。

col: hire a van｜租一辆厢式货车
load a van｜往厢式货车上装货
tip: 常指载货的封闭式车辆；不要与敞篷货车混淆。

senses.en: The particular way someone forms words when writing by hand.

ex.en: Your handwriting is much neater with this new pen.
ex.zh: 你用这支新笔写的字工整多了。

ex.en: Although digital devices are common in classrooms, clear handwriting remains useful for examinations and personal communication.
ex.zh: 虽然数字设备在课堂上很常见，但清晰的手写字在考试和个人交流中仍然有用。

tip: 通常不可数；优美书法这门艺术用calligraphy。

senses.en: shaped like a circle or ball
one stage in a repeated series of activities
around something or on all sides of it

ex.en: We placed a round table beside the kitchen window.
ex.zh: 我们在厨房窗边放了一张圆桌。

ex.en: A further round of negotiations may help governments reach an agreement on reducing industrial emissions.
ex.zh: 新一轮谈判可能有助于各国政府就减少工业排放达成协议。

col: a round of talks｜一轮会谈
walk round the lake｜绕湖散步
tip: round作介词常见于英式英语，美式多用around。

senses.en: A special occasion when people celebrate a tradition or event
An organised series of performances or other cultural events

ex.en: Our town holds a lantern festival every autumn.
ex.zh: 我们镇每年秋天都会举办灯会。

ex.en: An annual arts festival can attract visitors while providing local performers with valuable opportunities to reach wider audiences.
ex.zh: 一年一度的艺术节既能吸引游客，也能为当地表演者提供接触更多观众的宝贵机会。

col: hold a festival｜举办节庆活动
tip: festival强调庆祝或系列活动，不一定是放假的holiday。

senses.en: to join things together or link them electronically
to recognize or establish a relationship between things
to develop a good relationship with someone

ex.en: Connect your phone to the speaker using this cable.
ex.zh: 用这根线把手机连接到音箱上。

ex.en: New rail services can connect rural communities with cities, improving access to education and employment.
ex.zh: 新的铁路服务可以连接农村社区与城市，让人们更容易获得教育和就业机会。

col: connect to the internet｜连接互联网
connect A with B｜把A与B联系起来
connect with people｜与人建立联系
tip: 连接设备常用connect A to B。

senses.en: to close something with a zip; to move very quickly
a fastener with two rows of teeth that lock together
lively energy and speed

ex.en: Please zip up your jacket before we go outside.
ex.zh: 我们出门前请把你的夹克拉上。

ex.en: The new high-speed train can zip between the two cities in just under an hour, which saves passengers a lot of time.
ex.zh: 这列新高铁不到一小时就能在两座城市之间飞驰而过，为乘客节省了很多时间。

tip: 拉上拉链用zip up；英式英语zip也作名词“拉链”，美式常用zipper。

senses.en: To get something that someone sends, gives, or provides.
To welcome someone arriving at a place.

ex.en: Did you receive the photos I sent yesterday?
ex.zh: 你收到我昨天发的照片了吗？

ex.en: All residents should receive clear information about changes to public transport before new routes are introduced.
ex.zh: 在新线路开通之前，所有居民都应获得有关公共交通调整的明确信息。

col: receive an email｜收到电子邮件
receive a warm welcome｜受到热烈欢迎
tip: receive侧重收到；accept侧重愿意接受。

senses.en: the hard outer shell of a sea animal

ex.en: She picked up a pink seashell on the beach.
ex.zh: 她在海滩上捡起一枚粉色的贝壳。

ex.en: The children collected seashells and used them to decorate their classroom display about the ocean.
ex.zh: 孩子们收集贝壳，用来装饰教室里关于海洋的展览。

tip: seashell多指海边捡到的贝壳；shell泛指壳。

senses.en: Taking long walks outdoors, especially in the countryside.

ex.en: These boots keep my feet dry when I go hiking.
ex.zh: 我去远足时，这双靴子能让双脚保持干爽。

ex.en: Hiking offers an affordable way to improve physical health while encouraging people to appreciate natural landscapes.
ex.zh: 徒步旅行是一种经济实惠的健身方式，也能鼓励人们欣赏自然风光。

tip: 通常指乡野长途步行；也可作hike的现在分词。

senses.en: Having hair that is pale yellow or golden.
A person with pale yellow or golden hair.

ex.en: His blond hair looked almost white in the sunshine.
ex.zh: 他的金发在阳光下看起来几乎是白色的。

ex.en: In discussions of inherited traits, blond hair is often used as an example of human physical variation.
ex.zh: 讨论遗传特征时，金发常被用作人类外貌差异的例子。

tip: blonde常用于女性；词义不限定肤色。

senses.en: a visible spot, line, or symbol on a surface
a score showing the quality of a student's work
to indicate something visibly or assess a student's work

ex.en: Your wet glass left a mark on the table.
ex.zh: 你的湿杯子在桌上留下了一道印子。

ex.en: Teachers should mark assignments consistently so that students receive fair and useful feedback.
ex.zh: 教师批改作业时应采用一致的标准，让学生获得公平且有用的反馈。

tip: 表示考试分数常用复数marks，尤其在英式英语中。

senses.en: extremely large in size, amount, or degree

ex.en: A huge dog was sleeping beside the tiny kitten.
ex.zh: 一只大狗正睡在那只小猫旁边。

ex.en: Investing in public transport could bring huge benefits to cities struggling with congestion and air pollution.
ex.zh: 对于饱受交通拥堵和空气污染困扰的城市，投资公共交通可以带来巨大益处。

tip: 本身表示极大，常用absolutely huge加强语气。

senses.en: an infectious illness causing fever, aches, and tiredness

ex.en: She stayed in bed all weekend with the flu.
ex.zh: 她得了流感，整个周末都卧床休息。

ex.en: Annual flu vaccinations can help protect vulnerable people and reduce pressure on hospitals during winter.
ex.zh: 每年接种流感疫苗有助于保护易感人群，并减轻冬季医院的压力。

tip: flu通常不可数；英式常说have flu，美式常加the。

senses.en: A public message promoting a product, service, event, or opportunity.

ex.en: I saw an advertisement for bicycles at the station.
ex.zh: 我在车站看到了一则自行车广告。

ex.en: Advertisements aimed at young consumers should present accurate information rather than encourage unnecessary spending.
ex.zh: 面向年轻消费者的广告应提供准确信息，而不是鼓励不必要的消费。

tip: 广告内容用 for 引出；advertising 泛指广告活动。

senses.en: A team sport using sticks to hit a ball or puck

ex.en: We practised hockey on the school field yesterday.
ex.zh: 昨天我们在学校运动场练习了曲棍球。

ex.en: Making hockey facilities more accessible could encourage greater participation in team sports among young people.
ex.zh: 让曲棍球设施更便于使用，可以鼓励更多年轻人参加团队运动。

tip: 英国通常指草地曲棍球；美国通常指冰球。

senses.en: An unexpected event that causes injury or damage.
Something that happens without being planned or intended.

ex.en: Luckily, nobody was hurt in the accident outside our house.
ex.zh: 幸好，我们家外面发生的事故没有造成人员受伤。

ex.en: Better street lighting can reduce the risk of accidents involving cyclists and pedestrians at night.
ex.zh: 改善街道照明可以降低夜间涉及骑车人和行人的事故风险。

col: a road accident｜道路交通事故
tip: by accident表示无意中，反义短语是on purpose。

senses.en: A formal talk given to an audience.
The ability or act of expressing thoughts through spoken words.

ex.en: Leila practised her speech in front of the mirror.
ex.zh: 莱拉对着镜子练习演讲。

ex.en: In his speech, the researcher explained how access to green spaces can improve children's mental health.
ex.zh: 研究人员在演讲中解释了接触绿地如何改善儿童的心理健康。

tip: 一次演讲用a speech；说话能力通常不可数。

senses.en: relating to Mexico, its people or its culture
a person from Mexico

ex.en: My neighbour cooked a Mexican dish with beans and rice.
ex.zh: 我的邻居做了一道有豆子和米饭的墨西哥菜。

ex.en: The class compared Mexican food and Chinese food as part of a culture project.
ex.zh: 作为文化项目的一部分，全班比较了墨西哥菜和中国菜。

tip: 表示国籍时首字母要大写：a Mexican teacher。

senses.en: A large area of water surrounded by land.

ex.en: We rented a small boat and crossed the lake.
ex.zh: 我们租了一条小船，划到了湖对岸。

ex.en: Agricultural pollution can damage lake ecosystems and threaten the communities that rely on them for drinking water.
ex.zh: 农业污染会破坏湖泊生态系统，并威胁依靠湖水获取饮用水的社区。

col: the shore of a lake｜湖岸
tip: on the lake 指在湖面上；in the lake 指在湖水中。

senses.en: decayed and not good to eat
very bad or unfair

ex.en: The rotten apples in the basket smelled terrible and attracted flies.
ex.zh: 篮子里腐烂的苹果闻起来很糟糕，还引来了苍蝇。

ex.en: We should throw away rotten food immediately to keep the kitchen clean and healthy.
ex.zh: 我们应该立即扔掉腐烂的食物，以保持厨房清洁和健康。

tip: 口语中 feel rotten 表示身体不舒服或心情糟糕。

senses.en: comfortable clothes worn in bed

ex.en: He put on his warm pajamas and went to bed.
ex.zh: 他穿上暖和的睡衣去睡觉了。

ex.en: Children often wear soft pajamas while reading a story before bedtime.
ex.zh: 孩子们睡前读故事时常穿柔软的睡衣。

col: a pair of pajamas｜一套睡衣
tip: 英式拼作 pyjamas，常用复数，说 a pair of pajamas。

senses.en: A section of writing dealing with one main idea.

ex.en: This paragraph is too long for a quick email.
ex.zh: 对于一封简短的邮件来说，这一段太长了。

ex.en: Each paragraph in an academic essay should develop a clear argument supported by relevant evidence.
ex.zh: 学术文章的每一段都应展开一个清晰的论点，并以相关证据加以支持。

tip: 可数名词；写作中通常一段围绕一个中心意思。

senses.en: An opportunity to do something.
The likelihood that something will happen.
Events happening without planning or a predictable cause.

ex.en: Can you give me another chance to explain?
ex.zh: 你能再给我一次解释的机会吗？

ex.en: Affordable training gives unemployed adults a chance to gain new skills and return to the workforce.
ex.zh: 费用可负担的培训让失业的成年人有机会掌握新技能，重返职场。

col: a chance to learn｜学习的机会
a good chance of｜很有可能
tip: 机会用chance to do；可能性常用chance of doing。

senses.en: the activity of visiting interesting places as a tourist

ex.en: We spent the morning sightseeing around the old harbour.
ex.zh: 我们花了一上午在老港口一带观光。

ex.en: Sightseeing tours can support local economies, especially when visitors choose guides and businesses from the community.
ex.zh: 观光游览能促进当地经济，尤其是在游客选择当地社区的导游和商家时。

tip: 不可数名词；说go sightseeing，不加a。

senses.en: to put your hand or another body part against something
the sense of feeling things through skin, or physical contact
to make someone feel a strong, often tender emotion

ex.en: Please don't touch the pan; it is still hot.
ex.zh: 请别碰锅，它还很烫。

ex.en: Digital communication helps families stay in touch, even when work or study separates them across countries.
ex.zh: 即使工作或学习使家人分居不同国家，数字通信也能帮助他们保持联系。

tip: 保持联系用keep in touch with someone。

senses.en: A picture made with a pencil, pen, or similar tool.
The activity or skill of making pictures with lines.

ex.en: He showed me a drawing of his cat.
ex.zh: 他给我看了一幅他画的猫。

ex.en: Drawing can help children express emotions that they may find difficult to communicate through spoken language.
ex.zh: 绘画可以帮助儿童表达那些难以用口头语言传达的情感。

tip: 指一幅画时可数；指绘画活动时通常不可数。

senses.en: Sweet food eaten at the end of a meal.

ex.en: We shared a bowl of ice cream for dessert.
ex.zh: 我们分吃了一碗冰淇淋作为餐后甜点。

ex.en: Offering fresh fruit for dessert can help school cafeterias encourage healthier eating habits among children.
ex.zh: 学校食堂提供新鲜水果作为餐后甜点，有助于培养儿童更健康的饮食习惯。

tip: dessert有两个s，重音在后；desert作沙漠时重音在前。

senses.en: a place serving meals in a school or workplace
a container used to carry drinking water outdoors

ex.en: We usually eat lunch together in the school canteen.
ex.zh: 我们通常一起在学校食堂吃午饭。

ex.en: Providing affordable healthy meals in the workplace canteen can improve employee wellbeing and productivity.
ex.zh: 在工作场所的食堂提供价格实惠的健康餐食，可以改善员工的身心健康并提高生产力。

tip: 英式英语中常指食堂；美式英语常用cafeteria。

senses.en: A person or company that constructs or repairs buildings.

ex.en: The builder replaced the broken bricks around our doorway.
ex.zh: 建筑工人更换了我们家门口周围破损的砖块。

ex.en: Builders can reduce construction waste by choosing durable materials and planning resource use more carefully.
ex.zh: 建筑商可以通过选择耐用材料和更细致地规划资源使用来减少建筑垃圾。

col: hire a builder｜雇用建筑工人
tip: 可指建筑工人，也可指承建房屋的公司。

senses.en: Find an answer to a problem or mystery

ex.en: We solved the puzzle together after dinner last night.
ex.zh: 昨晚晚饭后，我们一起解开了那道谜题。

ex.en: Improving public transport could help solve traffic problems in rapidly growing urban areas.
ex.zh: 改善公共交通有助于解决快速发展城区的交通问题。

tip: solve直接接问题；“溶解”用dissolve。

senses.en: A utensil with a small bowl for eating or serving.
To move or serve food using a spoon.

ex.en: She stirred her soup with a wooden spoon.
ex.zh: 她用木勺搅了搅汤。

ex.en: Teaching children to use a spoon independently can help develop their coordination and confidence.
ex.zh: 教孩子独立使用勺子有助于培养他们的协调能力和自信心。

col: spoon into a bowl｜用勺舀入碗中
tip: 一勺的量通常用 a spoonful of 表达。

senses.en: To have a different opinion from someone else.
To give different information or results.

ex.en: We disagree about which colour to paint the kitchen.
ex.zh: 我们对于厨房该刷什么颜色意见不一。

ex.en: Experts disagree on whether free public transport is the most effective way to reduce urban traffic.
ex.zh: 专家对于免费公共交通是否是减少城市交通流量的最有效方法意见不一。

col: disagree with someone｜不同意某人的看法
disagree about something｜在某事上意见不合
tip: 不同意某人用disagree with；争议话题用on或about。

senses.en: A person who writes books, articles, or other written works.
To write a book, report, or other written work.

ex.en: The author answered questions about her new adventure novel.
ex.zh: 这位作者回答了有关她新出版的冒险小说的问题。

ex.en: An author can challenge social attitudes by presenting familiar problems through the experiences of unfamiliar characters.
ex.zh: 作者可以借助陌生人物的经历呈现熟悉的问题，从而挑战社会观念。

col: the author of a novel｜一部小说的作者
tip: “……的作者”用the author of；也可作动词。

senses.en: A substance used with water to clean skin or objects.
A continuing television or radio drama about everyday relationships.
To rub or wash something with soap.

ex.en: Please wash your hands with soap before lunch.
ex.zh: 午饭前请用肥皂洗手。

ex.en: Providing clean water and soap in schools can help prevent infections and improve children's overall health.
ex.zh: 在学校提供清洁用水和肥皂有助于预防感染，改善儿童的整体健康状况。

col: a bar of soap｜一块肥皂
tip: 指清洁用品通常不可数；一块用a bar of soap。

senses.en: A small, round, green seed eaten as a vegetable

ex.en: She added frozen peas to the vegetable soup.
ex.zh: 她往蔬菜汤里加了些冷冻豌豆。

ex.en: Growing peas and other vegetables at school can help children understand where their food comes from.
ex.zh: 在学校种植豌豆和其他蔬菜，可以帮助孩子了解食物的来源。

tip: 可数名词；泛指食用的豌豆通常用复数peas。

senses.zh: 色彩鲜艳的；五彩缤纷的
senses.en: Having many bright colours

senses.zh: 生动有趣的；丰富多彩的
senses.en: Full of interesting, unusual or exciting details

ex.en: Colourful balloons floated above the tables at the party.
ex.zh: 聚会上，五彩缤纷的气球飘浮在桌子上方。

ex.en: Colourful public murals can transform neglected urban spaces and encourage residents to take pride in their neighbourhoods.
ex.zh: 色彩鲜艳的公共壁画能改变被忽视的城市空间，增强居民对社区的自豪感。

col: a colourful character｜有趣独特的人物
a colourful history｜丰富多彩的历史
tip: 英式拼写colourful，美式拼写colorful。

senses.en: as stated or reported by someone or something
following a rule, plan, or particular standard

ex.en: According to the forecast, rain will arrive this afternoon.
ex.zh: 据天气预报，今天下午会下雨。

ex.en: According to recent research, regular physical activity can improve concentration and reduce stress among university students.
ex.zh: 根据近期研究，经常进行体育活动可以提高大学生的专注力并减轻压力。

col: according to the rules｜按照规则
tip: 引述他人观点用according to；自己的观点用in my opinion。

senses.en: To send something through the air using your hand
To organise and host a party
An act of throwing, or the distance something is thrown

ex.en: Throw me the ball before the dog grabs it.
ex.zh: 趁狗还没抢到球，快把球扔给我。

ex.en: Schools can teach children to throw and catch safely through games that develop coordination and teamwork.
ex.zh: 学校可以通过培养协调能力和团队精神的游戏，教孩子安全地投接球。

tip: 不规则变化：throw–threw–thrown；聚会也可用throw。

senses.en: Very unpleasant to experience, taste, smell, or see.
Deliberately unkind or hurtful towards another person.
Severe or painful, especially describing an illness or injury.

ex.en: A nasty smell came from the kitchen bin.
ex.zh: 厨房垃圾桶里散发出一股难闻的气味。

ex.en: Nasty comments on social media can discourage young people from participating in otherwise valuable online discussions.
ex.zh: 社交媒体上的恶意评论可能使年轻人不愿参与原本有价值的网络讨论。

tip: 比bad更带厌恶感；形容人时通常指刻薄、不友善。

senses.en: to make something clear or easy to understand
to give or be the reason why something happens

ex.en: Could you explain how this coffee machine works?
ex.zh: 你能说明一下这台咖啡机怎么用吗？

ex.en: Differences in access to healthcare may partly explain why life expectancy varies considerably between regions.
ex.zh: 医疗服务可及性的差异，可能在一定程度上解释不同地区预期寿命差距较大的原因。

col: explain something to someone｜向某人解释某事
tip: 说explain something to someone，不说explain someone。

senses.en: Used when something may happen or may be true.
Used with can or could to emphasise possibility or difficulty.

ex.en: We could possibly have a picnic if the rain stops.
ex.zh: 如果雨停了，我们也许可以去野餐。

ex.en: Expanding urban green spaces could possibly reduce summer temperatures while improving residents' physical and mental health.
ex.zh: 扩大城市绿地可能降低夏季气温，同时改善居民的身心健康。

tip: can't possibly表示“绝不可能”，语气很强。

senses.en: A shiny greyish-white precious metal used for jewellery and coins.
Having a shiny greyish-white colour, or made of silver.
A medal awarded for second place in a competition.

ex.en: This little spoon is made of pure silver.
ex.zh: 这把小勺子是纯银做的。

ex.en: Silver is widely used in electronic devices because it conducts electricity exceptionally well.
ex.zh: 银的导电性能极佳，因此被广泛用于电子设备。

tip: 表示金属银时不可数；a silver可指一枚银牌。

senses.en: A reproduction, or one example of a book or document
To reproduce something or imitate someone's actions
Written material prepared for publication or advertising

ex.en: Please keep a copy of the receipt at home.
ex.zh: 请在家里留一份收据副本。

ex.en: Students should learn to evaluate sources rather than simply copy information from websites into their assignments.
ex.zh: 学生应学会评估资料来源，而不是直接把网站信息抄进作业。

tip: 复数为copies；广告文案义的copy通常不可数。

senses.en: The activity of going from one place to another
Moving between places rather than staying in one location
Going from one place to another

ex.en: Travelling by train gives me time to enjoy the scenery.
ex.zh: 乘火车旅行让我有时间欣赏沿途风景。

ex.en: Travelling abroad can broaden students' perspectives by exposing them to different customs and ways of life.
ex.zh: 出国旅行能让学生接触不同的习俗和生活方式，从而拓宽视野。

tip: 英式拼写双写l；美式通常写traveling。

senses.en: in a way that is not the same

ex.en: My sister and I arrange our desks differently.
ex.zh: 我和姐姐布置书桌的方式不同。

ex.en: Students learn differently, so teachers should offer varied activities rather than rely on a single method.
ex.zh: 学生的学习方式各不相同，因此教师应提供多样化活动，而不是依赖单一方法。

col: treat someone differently｜区别对待某人
do things differently｜换种方式做事
tip: 副词修饰动词；形容人或事物不同用different。

senses.en: A member of the police.
A member of the armed forces with authority to command.
Someone with an official role in an organisation or government.

ex.en: A police officer helped us find the station.
ex.zh: 一位警察帮我们找到了车站。

ex.en: A local housing officer can advise residents on applying for affordable accommodation and accessing financial support.
ex.zh: 当地住房事务官员可以指导居民申请可负担住房并获取经济援助。

tip: officer可指警察或军官，具体含义看搭配。

senses.en: a large black and white bear native to China

ex.en: The panda sat quietly, chewing a fresh bamboo shoot.
ex.zh: 那只大熊猫静静地坐着，嚼着一根新鲜竹笋。

ex.en: Protecting panda habitats also benefits other species that depend on the same mountain forests for survival.
ex.zh: 保护大熊猫栖息地也有益于其他依赖同一片山林生存的物种。

tip: panda通常指大熊猫；red panda指小熊猫。

senses.en: knowledge or skill gained by doing things
something that happens to you or that you do
to have something happen to you or feel something

ex.en: My sister has years of experience repairing old bicycles.
ex.zh: 我姐姐有多年修理旧自行车的经验。

ex.en: Work experience can help graduates develop practical skills that employers value alongside academic qualifications.
ex.zh: 工作经验能帮助毕业生培养实践技能，而雇主不仅重视学历，也看重这些技能。

col: a rewarding experience｜有收获的经历
tip: 表“经验”不可数；表具体“经历”可数。

senses.en: Become greater in amount or size, or make something greater
A rise in the amount, size, or level of something

ex.en: The bakery increased its prices again this week.
ex.zh: 这家面包店本周又涨价了。

ex.en: An increase in public transport investment could reduce traffic congestion and improve air quality in cities.
ex.zh: 增加公共交通投资可以缓解交通拥堵，并改善城市空气质量。

col: an increase in demand｜需求的增长
tip: 动词重音在后，名词在前；by接增量，to接终值。

senses.en: To be owned by someone
To have a proper place or category
To feel accepted as part of a group

ex.en: This blue umbrella belongs to my younger sister.
ex.zh: 这把蓝色雨伞是我妹妹的。

ex.en: Community centres provide welcoming spaces where newcomers can feel they belong and build lasting friendships.
ex.zh: 社区中心提供友好的空间，让新来者获得归属感并建立持久的友谊。

col: belong in a museum｜应放在博物馆
feel you belong｜感到有归属感
tip: belong to表示属于，不用被动语态或进行时。

senses.en: Nearly, but not completely or not quite.

ex.en: I almost missed the bus while tying my shoes.
ex.zh: 我系鞋带时差点错过了公交车。

ex.en: Almost all participants agreed that affordable public transport would improve their access to employment opportunities.
ex.zh: 几乎所有参与者都认为，价格实惠的公共交通能让他们获得更多就业机会。

tip: almost可接all、every和no；不能直接接most。

senses.en: A device that records and plays sound using magnetic tape.

ex.en: My grandfather still uses a tape-recorder to record songs.
ex.zh: 我祖父仍用磁带录音机录制歌曲。

ex.en: Before digital devices became widespread, researchers often used a tape-recorder to preserve interviews for later analysis.
ex.zh: 在数字设备普及之前，研究人员常用磁带录音机保存访谈内容，以供后续分析。

col: a portable tape-recorder｜便携式磁带录音机
a cassette tape-recorder｜盒式磁带录音机
tip: 现代通常写作tape recorder，不加连字符。

senses.en: Precisely, with no difference or error.
Used to confirm that something is completely correct.

ex.en: This jacket is exactly the colour I wanted.
ex.zh: 这件夹克正是我想要的颜色。

ex.en: Researchers must record exactly how much energy each household uses to ensure reliable comparisons between regions.
ex.zh: 研究人员必须准确记录每户家庭的能耗，以确保地区之间的比较可靠。

tip: not exactly常表示并非完全，也可委婉否定。

senses.en: One or the other of two; each of two sides.
One or the other of two people or things.
Also not, used after a negative statement.

ex.en: You can borrow either umbrella; both are dry.
ex.zh: 两把伞你随便借哪把都行，都是干的。

ex.en: Students can choose either vocational training or university education, depending on their interests and career goals.
ex.zh: 学生可以根据自己的兴趣和职业目标，选择职业培训或大学教育。

col: either side｜两边中的任一边；两边各自
either of them｜他们两者中的任一个
tip: either…or…表二选一；否定句末either表“也不”。

senses.en: A place where people stay temporarily, often in tents.
Stay outdoors temporarily in a tent or similar shelter.
A group sharing the same opinions or aims.

ex.en: We returned to camp before the rain started.
ex.zh: 我们在下雨前回到了营地。

ex.en: Schools can organise outdoor camps to help students develop independence and learn practical skills beyond the classroom.
ex.zh: 学校可以组织户外营地活动，帮助学生培养独立性并学习课堂之外的实用技能。

tip: go camping表示去露营；camp也可指观点相同的阵营。

senses.en: Quickly and unexpectedly, with little or no warning.

ex.en: The lights suddenly went out while we were cooking.
ex.zh: 我们做饭时，灯突然灭了。

ex.en: When demand suddenly increases, public transport systems may struggle to provide enough services for passengers.
ex.zh: 当需求突然增加时，公共交通系统可能难以为乘客提供足够的班次。

tip: 可置于句首或动词前；强调变化突然、事先无预兆。

senses.en: A substance that spreads freely to fill its container.
Gas used as fuel for heating or cooking.
Petrol used to power vehicles, in American English.

ex.en: We use gas to cook our meals at home.
ex.zh: 我们在家用燃气做饭。

ex.en: Reducing greenhouse gas emissions requires investment in cleaner energy and more efficient public transport systems.
ex.zh: 减少温室气体排放需要投资更清洁的能源和更高效的公共交通系统。

tip: 泛指气体通常不可数；多种气体用gases。

senses.en: A tool with two blades for cutting things.

ex.en: Please use these scissors to cut the wrapping paper.
ex.zh: 请用这把剪刀裁剪包装纸。

ex.en: Teachers should supervise young children when they use scissors during classroom craft activities.
ex.zh: 幼儿在课堂手工活动中使用剪刀时，教师应在旁监督。

col: a pair of scissors｜一把剪刀
tip: 通常用复数；一把剪刀说a pair of scissors。

senses.en: A small ornamental fish, often orange, kept in ponds or tanks.

ex.en: Our goldfish swims between the plants in its large tank.
ex.zh: 我们的金鱼在大鱼缸里的水草间游来游去。

ex.en: Keeping goldfish in suitably sized tanks can teach children responsibility and the importance of animal welfare.
ex.zh: 在大小适宜的鱼缸里养金鱼，可以教会孩子承担责任，并认识动物福利的重要性。

tip: goldfish单复数同形：one goldfish，two goldfish。

senses.en: the rear part of an animal or an aircraft
to follow someone closely and watch where they go

ex.en: The dog wagged its tail when I came home.
ex.zh: 我回家时，那只狗摇起了尾巴。

ex.en: Some animals use their tails for balance, which helps them move safely through complex forest habitats.
ex.zh: 一些动物用尾巴保持平衡，这有助于它们在复杂的森林栖息地中安全移动。

tip: tail指尾巴；tale指故事，两词同音。

senses.en: Belonging to a particular person, rather than someone else.
To have something that legally belongs to you.

ex.en: I finally have my own room in our new flat.
ex.zh: 在我们的新公寓里，我终于有了自己的房间。

ex.en: People who own their homes may feel more financially secure, although maintenance costs can be substantial.
ex.zh: 拥有住房的人可能在经济上更有安全感，不过房屋维护费用也可能相当高。

col: my own room｜我自己的房间
of your own｜属于你自己的
tip: own表“自己的”前通常有物主词，如my own。

senses.en: To mark a special occasion by doing something enjoyable.
To praise someone or something publicly.

ex.en: We cooked a special dinner to celebrate her graduation.
ex.zh: 我们做了一顿特别的晚餐来庆祝她毕业。

ex.en: Community festivals celebrate local traditions while giving residents opportunities to strengthen relationships with their neighbours.
ex.zh: 社区节庆活动在弘扬当地传统的同时，也让居民有机会增进邻里关系。

col: celebrate an achievement｜庆祝一项成就
tip: 庆祝某事用celebrate；祝贺某人用congratulate。

senses.en: made of wood
showing little natural feeling or movement

ex.en: She stirred the soup slowly with a wooden spoon.
ex.zh: 她用木勺慢慢搅拌汤。

ex.en: Wooden buildings can offer environmental benefits when their materials come from responsibly managed forests.
ex.zh: 如果木材来自负责任管理的森林，木制建筑就能带来环境效益。

tip: wooden指木制；woody多指木质或像木头的。

senses.en: a system that allows devices to connect to the internet without wires
relating to a wireless internet connection

ex.en: The café offers free Wi-Fi to all its customers.
ex.zh: 这家咖啡馆为所有顾客提供免费Wi-Fi。

ex.en: Many schools now provide Wi-Fi so that students can use online learning materials in class.
ex.zh: 许多学校现在提供Wi-Fi，以便学生在课堂上使用在线学习资料。

tip: Wi-Fi是商标，但通用。注意首字母大写，中间有连字符。

senses.en: needed for a particular purpose or situation

ex.en: Take a warm coat if you think it's necessary.
ex.zh: 如果你觉得有必要，就带上一件暖和的外套。

ex.en: Investment in public transport is necessary to reduce traffic congestion and improve urban air quality.
ex.zh: 投资公共交通对于缓解交通拥堵和改善城市空气质量是必要的。

tip: 常用it is necessary to do；necessarily意为“必然地”。

senses.en: To offer an idea or possible action for consideration.
To indicate that something may be true.

ex.en: I suggest taking an umbrella because those clouds look dark.
ex.zh: 我建议带把伞，因为那些云看起来很阴沉。

ex.en: Recent studies suggest that access to green spaces can improve mental health among urban residents.
ex.zh: 近期研究表明，能够接触绿地可能有助于改善城市居民的心理健康。

col: suggest a solution｜提出解决方案
tip: 用suggest doing或suggest that从句，不用suggest to do。

senses.en: A system that cools indoor air and controls humidity.

ex.en: Please turn on the air-conditioning before the guests arrive.
ex.zh: 请在客人到来之前打开空调。

ex.en: Greater reliance on air-conditioning during heatwaves can place considerable pressure on urban electricity supplies.
ex.zh: 热浪期间对空调依赖加深，可能给城市电力供应带来很大压力。

col: turn on the air-conditioning｜打开空调
tip: 不可数；一台空调机用an air conditioner。

senses.en: Untidy or dirty, with things scattered or out of place.
Complicated and difficult to deal with.

ex.en: His desk was messy after an afternoon of painting.
ex.zh: 画了一下午画后，他的书桌变得脏乱不堪。

ex.en: Without clear responsibilities, cooperation between public agencies can become messy and delay the delivery of essential services.
ex.zh: 如果没有明确的职责，公共机构之间的合作可能变得混乱，延误基本服务的提供。

tip: messy可指物品脏乱，也可指局面复杂难处理。

senses.en: Not long ago, or during the period just before now.

ex.en: We recently moved into a flat near the river.
ex.zh: 我们最近搬进了河边的一套公寓。

ex.en: Researchers have recently explored how access to green spaces influences the mental health of urban residents.
ex.zh: 研究人员最近探讨了绿地的可及性如何影响城市居民的心理健康。

tip: 可用于一般过去时或现在完成时，不只限于完成时。

senses.en: mainly, or for the largest part

ex.en: My weekend was mostly spent cooking and reading.
ex.zh: 我的周末大部分时间都用来做饭和看书了。

ex.en: In many rural areas, residents rely mostly on private vehicles because public transport services are limited.
ex.zh: 在许多农村地区，由于公共交通服务有限，居民主要依靠私家车出行。

tip: mostly指大部分情况；almost指差一点或几乎。

senses.en: Relating to music, or showing skill and interest in it.
A play or film whose story includes songs and dancing.
Having a pleasant sound resembling music.

ex.en: He keeps his musical instruments beside the sofa.
ex.zh: 他把乐器放在沙发旁边。

ex.en: Schools that offer musical training give children valuable opportunities to develop creativity and practise teamwork.
ex.zh: 提供音乐训练的学校为孩子们培养创造力和练习团队合作提供了宝贵机会。

tip: 作形容词指“音乐的”；作可数名词指音乐剧等。

senses.en: to move quickly back and forth, or cause this movement
to upset someone deeply or weaken their confidence
a quick movement back and forth

ex.en: Shake the bottle well before pouring juice into your glass.
ex.zh: 把果汁倒进杯子前，先充分摇匀瓶子。

ex.en: Repeated failures in public transport can shake commuters' confidence in the reliability of urban services.
ex.zh: 公共交通反复出现故障，可能动摇通勤者对城市服务可靠性的信心。

tip: 不规则变化：shake—shook—shaken。

senses.en: a unit of volume equal to one thousand millilitres

ex.en: We need a litre of milk for this pudding.
ex.zh: 做这道布丁需要一升牛奶。

ex.en: Measuring household water use in litres can help residents understand consumption and identify opportunities to reduce waste.
ex.zh: 以升为单位测量家庭用水量，有助于居民了解消耗情况并找到减少浪费的方法。

col: a litre of milk｜一升牛奶
tip: 英式拼写litre，美式liter；复数加s。

senses.en: An act of cutting hair, or the resulting hairstyle.

ex.en: I need a haircut before my cousin's wedding.
ex.zh: 表亲的婚礼之前，我需要理个发。

ex.en: Offering affordable haircuts at community centres can help trainee hairdressers gain practical experience while serving local residents.
ex.zh: 在社区中心提供价格实惠的理发服务，能让实习理发师在服务当地居民的同时积累实践经验。

tip: 说get或have a haircut，不说cut a haircut。

senses.en: to believe that something will probably happen
to regard something as necessary or reasonably required
to believe someone or something will arrive soon

ex.en: We expect rain, so take an umbrella with you.
ex.zh: 我们预计会下雨，所以带上雨伞吧。

ex.en: Employers increasingly expect graduates to demonstrate practical skills as well as a strong understanding of their subject.
ex.zh: 雇主越来越期望毕业生既展现实践技能，又具备扎实的专业知识。

col: expect to do something｜预计做某事
expect someone to do something｜期望某人做某事
tip: expect偏重认为会发生，hope偏重希望发生。

senses.en: a tropical fruit with rough skin and sweet yellow flesh

ex.en: She sliced a fresh pineapple for our picnic.
ex.zh: 她为我们的野餐切了一个新鲜菠萝。

ex.en: Growing pineapple for export can support rural incomes, but intensive farming may damage local soils.
ex.zh: 种植菠萝用于出口可以增加农村收入，但集约化种植可能损害当地土壤。

tip: 整个菠萝可数，作为食物的菠萝果肉常不可数。

senses.en: One of the hard parts forming a body's supporting frame.
To remove the bones from meat or fish.

ex.en: He broke a bone in his wrist while skating.
ex.zh: 他滑冰时摔断了手腕的一块骨头。

ex.en: Regular weight-bearing exercise helps maintain bone strength and can reduce the risk of fractures in older adults.
ex.zh: 规律的负重运动有助于保持骨骼强度，并能降低老年人骨折的风险。

tip: bone作动词指去骨；boneless表示无骨的。

senses.en: a container with a handle and spout for making and serving tea

ex.en: Grandma poured hot water into the teapot and added some tea leaves.
ex.zh: 奶奶把热水倒进茶壶，又加了些茶叶。

ex.en: At the school open day, students learned how a teapot is shaped on a potter's wheel.
ex.zh: 在学校开放日，学生们学习了如何在陶轮上给茶壶塑形。

col: put the kettle on｜烧水泡茶
tip: 合成词，重音在 tea 上；写作时注意 teapot 是一个词，不分开写。

senses.en: A smooth surface, usually glass, that shows a reflected image.
Show the same qualities, changes, or features as something else.

ex.en: He checked his hair in the mirror before leaving.
ex.zh: 他离开前照镜子检查了一下头发。

ex.en: Changes in consumer spending often mirror broader economic trends, particularly during periods of financial uncertainty.
ex.zh: 消费者支出的变化往往反映更广泛的经济趋势，在金融形势不明朗时期尤其如此。

tip: 照镜子用look in the mirror，不用look the mirror。

senses.en: A small, simple building, often made of wood or grass.

ex.en: We sheltered from the rain in a wooden hut.
ex.zh: 我们躲进一间木屋避雨。

ex.en: Mountain huts provide essential shelter for hikers, but their construction should minimise damage to fragile ecosystems.
ex.zh: 山间小屋为徒步者提供必要的庇护，但建造时应尽量减少对脆弱生态系统的破坏。

tip: hut强调简小朴素，通常不是设施齐全的住宅。

senses.en: Having a sharp taste like a lemon.
Having an unpleasant taste or smell after becoming spoiled.
To become less pleasant or make a relationship worse.

ex.en: These grapes are too sour for my taste.
ex.zh: 这些葡萄对我来说太酸了。

ex.en: Disagreements over shared resources can sour relations between neighbouring countries and delay important environmental projects.
ex.zh: 共享资源方面的分歧可能使邻国关系恶化，并延误重要的环境项目。

tip: go sour可指食物变质，也可指关系变坏。

senses.en: The money used in a particular country.
The state of being widely accepted or used.

ex.en: We exchanged our money for local currency at the airport.
ex.zh: 我们在机场把钱兑换成了当地货币。

ex.en: A weaker currency can attract international tourists by making accommodation and other services more affordable.
ex.zh: 货币贬值可以降低住宿和其他服务的价格，从而吸引国际游客。

tip: 货币种类可数；泛指货币通常不可数。

senses.en: in a happy and cheerful way
in a lively and pleasant way

ex.en: The children sang merrily on their way to the park.
ex.zh: 孩子们在去公园的路上快乐地唱歌。

ex.en: In the small town, the spring festival parade moved merrily through the main street.
ex.zh: 在这个小镇上，春节游行队伍欢快地穿过主街。

col: go merrily on｜继续欢快地进行
tip: 由形容词merry加-ly构成，多修饰唱歌、笑、走路等动作。

senses.en: An official award showing successful completion of education or training.
A skill or quality making someone suitable for a role.
A condition that limits the meaning or acceptance of something.

ex.en: This qualification helped me find work at a nursery.
ex.zh: 这个资格证书帮助我在一家幼儿园找到了工作。

ex.en: Employers increasingly value practical experience alongside formal qualifications when recruiting graduates for demanding professional roles.
ex.zh: 招聘毕业生担任要求较高的专业岗位时，雇主越来越重视实际经验与正式学历。

tip: 谈学历或资历常用复数qualifications。

senses.en: a pattern of lines read by a machine for price or info

ex.en: The cashier scanned the barcode and told me the price.
ex.zh: 收银员扫描了条形码并告诉我价格。

ex.en: Every product in the supermarket has a barcode, which helps staff check prices quickly.
ex.zh: 超市里的每件商品都有条形码，这帮助员工快速核对价格。

tip: 动词用 scan a barcode；barcode 也可写作 bar code，含义相同。

senses.en: An important subject or problem that needs discussion.
To officially announce or give something to people.
One edition of a regularly published newspaper or magazine.

ex.en: We discussed the parking issue at our neighbourhood meeting.
ex.zh: 我们在邻里会议上讨论了停车问题。

ex.en: Governments must address the issue of housing affordability to ensure that young adults can live independently.
ex.zh: 政府必须解决住房负担能力问题，确保年轻人能够独立生活。

col: a controversial issue｜有争议的议题
tip: issue 作问题常指需讨论的议题，不一定是困难。

senses.en: Inside a building, or into a building.

ex.en: We stayed indoors and played chess during the storm.
ex.zh: 暴风雨期间，我们待在室内下棋。

ex.en: Children who spend most of their time indoors may have fewer opportunities for physical activity.
ex.zh: 大部分时间待在室内的孩子可能较少有机会进行体育活动。

col: keep pets indoors｜把宠物养在室内
tip: indoors是副词；修饰名词用indoor，如indoor sports。

senses.en: not known or recognized

ex.en: The streets were unfamiliar, so we asked a local for directions.
ex.zh: 这些街道很陌生，所以我们向当地人问路。

ex.en: Students often feel nervous when they enter an unfamiliar school environment.
ex.zh: 学生们进入陌生的学校环境时常常感到紧张。

tip: 常用 be unfamiliar with sth 表示‘对某物不熟悉’。

senses.en: to surprise someone very much

ex.en: The magician's clever tricks never fail to amaze the children.
ex.zh: 魔术师巧妙的戏法总能让孩子们惊叹不已。

ex.en: Advances in medical technology continue to amaze researchers and offer new hope to patients with complex conditions.
ex.zh: 医疗技术的进步不断令研究人员惊叹，也为病情复杂的患者带来新的希望。

col: never cease to amaze｜始终令人惊叹
tip: 人感到惊奇用amazed；事物令人惊奇用amazing。

senses.en: relating to education or teaching

ex.en: The museum offers many educational programs for children.
ex.zh: 博物馆为孩子们提供许多教育项目。

ex.en: Playing educational games can help students learn new ideas while having fun.
ex.zh: 玩教育游戏可以帮助学生在娱乐中学习新知识。

tip: educational 强调“有教育意义的”，如 educational toys。
